stacking.note: Two dedicated rear 40G stacking ports. Stacks only with other MS350 models, including the MS350-24X. One 0.5 m stacking cable included

routing.summary: Static routing, OSPFv2, warm spare (VRRP), multicast routing (PIM-SM), DHCP server and relay. No BGP

routeScale: 16,384 routes (256 static); OSPF-learned routes capped at 15,000
licensing: Meraki Enterprise license required per switch (co-term or per-device); includes support

power.summary: Modular hot-swap PSU; one included, second slot for an optional redundant PSU

redundancy.detail: Second hot-swap PSU slot; the second PSU is sold separately
